title: NVIDIA FY2027 second-quarter results and third-quarter outlook
display_notice: Development analysis draft, not a prediction result; local Qwen was not used.
happened: The issuer reported FY2027 Q2 GAAP revenue of USD 96,221 million, net income of USD 59,688 million and gross margin of 75.0%. It also gave a Q3 management revenue outlook centered on USD 108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
new_info: The earlier FY2027 Q1 release gave management Q2 revenue outlook centered on USD 91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%; the current release supplies the actual. Any comparable gap must be calculated in code after unit conversion. This is not a market-consensus surprise.
affected: NVIDIA itself: reported revenue, margin, cash flow and subsequent management outlook.
AI infrastructure buyers as an industry: possible demand and purchasing-cost channels only; no specific counterparty relationship is verified here.
pathways: If reported Data Center demand turns into subsequent deliveries, future NVIDIA revenue may benefit, conditional on supply, pricing and product mix.

Cash capital purchases reduce issuer-defined free cash flow mechanically, but the reported measure also subtracts related principal payments; the cash purchase line is not total investment or new finance-lease assets.
The Q3 outlook assumes no China Data Center compute revenue. A change in market access could alter realization, but the saved material does not establish direction or size.
conditions: Orders convert to delivered products while prices, supply and mix support the outlook.
Later cash-flow and cash-purchase disclosures remain comparable in basis.
counterforces: Supply limits, weaker pricing or gross margin could offset revenue growth in profit and cash generation.
Regulation, regional sales limits, investment spending or principal payments could change cash conversion.
watch: Next-quarter actual revenue against management's USD 108.0 billion plus-or-minus-2% range, and GAAP gross margin.
Data Center revenue, operating cash flow, cash purchases of property/equipment/intangibles and related principal payments.
Later issuer disclosures about China Data Center compute assumptions and relevant regulation.
unknowns: No dated pre-release market consensus is available, so a market-expectations surprise is unknown.
Independent first-public availability, qualified historical security identity and event price reaction are absent.
No specific customer/supplier transmission link or comparable Q3 capex guide is established for this card.
